notes.title: Luctus Launches on September 29!
notes.content:
[p]Hello friends,[/p][p]The time has finally come!   

[b]Luctus will officially launch on Steam on September 29. [/b][/p][p]
This is a very special moment for us. 

After 2.5 years of hard work, we are so excited to finally share this journey with you. Step into a dark action-adventure filled with loss, betrayal, and shadows and carve your own path.[/p]

notes.title: Join the Luctus Playtest Now! 🎮
notes.content:
[p]Join the Luctus Playtest Now! 🎮  

You’re invited to join the Luctus Playtest on Steam. This is your chance to experience the full game early, completely free of charge. Signing up is simple: just visit the Luctus Steam page and register to participate.   

Don’t miss the opportunity to be part of the journey and help shape the final release. Join the playtest today![/p]

notes.title: Luctus - Devlog #1 The Architecture of Challange
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/0d7d27487224e554998d8f9d31813b00d6df0f5b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Big things are happening in Luctus! This update brings exploration, power, mystery, and story all in one go. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="y5efKlTJysU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]World Map[/b][/h3][p]Ever wondered where you are in the world? Now you’ll know![/p][p]The brand new World Map lets you see your location at a glance, making exploration feel bigger than ever.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/b1d5af4e4d8e76cb8537975cf1abb35dba456e15.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Skill Tree[/b][/h3][p]Time to grow stronger![/p][p]Unlock devastating new attack types and game changing passive abilities with the all-new Skill Tree. Your build, your playstyle.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/a4dfa2614cca99f60ab5ff6bc353985952b2a692.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Puzzles[/b][/h3][p]Sharpen your mind![/p][p]We’ve added fresh puzzle gameplay that challenges your wit as much as your reflexes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/1ccf7043759472b30c662ab31349d9f44e71fd47.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/631c9667cca5059be0ab2270ebcb8c38b374ec7f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]New Story Cutscenes[/b][/h3][p]The world of Luctus just got more cinematic.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/fd39f6ab69d105ca36e9f33ad1e43f793f4012ee.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/f454004e1aa39895736385c46f6275ed633528fd.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44562002/6a8bc76765d475e8ee19adb4b13ef3111e4ab520.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy brand new story cutscenes that bring the narrative to life in ways you’ve never seen before.[/p][p]All of this is showcased in our latest Devlog video with crisp GIFs so you can feel the update in action.[/p][p][/p][p]Watch it, feel it, and get ready for what’s coming next![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 We’re in the Steam Debut Festival! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]From August 7 to 11, LUCTUS will be featured on Steam among amazing debut titles from indie developers around the world.[/p][p]
🕯 Dive into our pixel-art action-adventure where you fight grief, uncover lost truths, and forge your path through fire and shadows.[/p]

notes.content:
Hello, hero!

You can now beat up the demo… but be careful, it might beat you up too! 💥
